claims.claim_text: NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom announced a collaboration to advance Korea's sovereign AI infrastructure using NVIDIA NVLink Fusion.
claims.excerpt: NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom today announced a collaboration to advance Korea’s sovereign AI infrastructure — using NVIDIA NVLink Fusion™ to bring together NVIDIA’s open infrastructure platform

claims.claim_text: Rebellions plans to use NVLink Fusion to connect its Rebel R200 neural processing units to the NVIDIA platform.
claims.excerpt: Rebellions will use NVLink Fusion to connect its Rebel R200 neural processing units (NPUs) to the NVIDIA platform, and harness the NVIDIA MGX™ rack architecture

claims.claim_text: SK Telecom plans to deploy these systems in its AI data center to support its full-stack sovereign AI strategy.
claims.excerpt: SK Telecom plans to deploy these systems in its AI data center to support its vision for full-stack sovereign AI spanning infrastructure, proprietary models and public-facing services

claims.claim_text: The companies plan to develop disaggregated inference, using NVIDIA GPUs for prefill and Rebellions NPUs for decode to improve inference throughput and power efficiency.
claims.excerpt: Their planned work includes using NVIDIA GPUs for prefill and Rebellions NPUs for decode to improve inference throughput and power efficiency.

claims.claim_text: Rebellions' R200 systems are expected to be ready for deployment in 2028.
claims.excerpt: Rebellions’ R200 systems are expected to be ready for deployment in 2028.

claims.claim_text: The collaboration is supported by Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT).
claims.excerpt: Supported by Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT), the collaboration aims to support AI services tailored to Korea’s language, industries and priorities

claims.claim_text: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said NVLink Fusion lets Korea's chipmakers connect their custom ASICs to NVIDIA's AI factory platform.
claims.excerpt: With NVLink Fusion, Korea’s chipmakers can connect their custom ASICs to NVIDIA’s AI factory platform, tightly coupling their processors with NVIDIA compute to run AI workloads.

claims.claim_text: Rebellions CEO Sunghyun Park said the company will deliver low-latency and energy-efficient inference for frontier models at scale.
claims.excerpt: we will deliver low-latency and energy-efficient inference for frontier models at scale.

claims.claim_text: SK Telecom plans to connect its infrastructure with its proprietary models and public-facing services, including those under Korea's AI for All project.
claims.excerpt: SK Telecom plans to connect this infrastructure with its proprietary foundation models and public-facing services, including those under the government’s AI for All project
